introHtml: Clear hand sanitizer lets you see the gel level at a glance, making it easy to monitor usage in high-traffic areas like lobbies and break rooms. The transparent bottles pair well with full-color sleeve printing, so your logo or safety message stands out without competing with the bottle's color. Choose from 1 oz squeeze pouches for giveaways or 2 oz cylinder bottles for desktops. Custom clear hand sanitizer keeps your brand visible while promoting hygiene.
